description: T14 harness manifest — install-dsh eval suite: happy-path (install/idempotency/cleanup) + planted failure classes (EFS encryption, junction handling, service-password handling). Scenario classes here are the coverage standard for the T11 eval dataset builder (COV-1: a declared class with no cases makes the dataset invalid).

scenario_classes.label: Happy path
scenario_classes.description: Normal install-dsh install, idempotency and cleanup on a clean Windows target

scenario_classes.label: EFS encryption
scenario_classes.description: Windows Encrypting File System (EFS): encrypted target dirs, encrypted sources, cleanup of encrypted artifacts

scenario_classes.label: Junction handling
scenario_classes.description: NTFS junction / reparse points: path resolution, bounded traversal (no recursion loops), junction-safe cleanup

scenario_classes.label: Service password handling
scenario_classes.description: Windows service account password change: credential update, service restart, failure-safe rollback

cases.title: Install creates DSH artifacts on a clean target
cases.description: On a clean target the install creates the DSH binary marker and the config file and reports success.
cases.pass_criteria: install returns ok; artifacts include bin/dsh and config/dsh.json

cases.title: Re-running install is idempotent
cases.description: Running install twice leaves the same file set: the second run does not duplicate or corrupt artifacts.
cases.pass_criteria: second install returns ok; file set after second run equals file set after first run

cases.title: Cleanup removes artifacts and is safe to repeat
cases.description: Cleanup removes the installed artifacts; a second cleanup is a safe no-op.
cases.pass_criteria: cleanup removes bin + config; second cleanup returns ok without error

cases.title: EFS-encrypted install target is detected
cases.description: When the install target directory is EFS-encrypted the skill must detect it and report an EFS-specific outcome instead of silently proceeding.
cases.pass_criteria: detected == true and message mentions EFS

cases.title: Copying from an EFS-encrypted source yields plaintext
cases.description: Copying a file from an EFS-encrypted source must produce readable plaintext at the destination, not a raw ciphertext blob.
cases.pass_criteria: destination content equals the plaintext (no ciphertext prefix)

cases.title: Cleanup removes EFS-encrypted artifacts
cases.description: Cleanup must remove artifacts inside an EFS-encrypted directory without leaving residue or failing.
cases.pass_criteria: after cleanup no install artifacts remain under the encrypted dir

cases.title: Junction path is resolved to its real target
cases.description: A path whose component is an NTFS junction must be resolved to the real target before file operations.
cases.pass_criteria: resolved path points at the junction target, not the link

cases.title: Traversal through junctions terminates
cases.description: Recursive traversal that crosses a junction (or a junction cycle) must terminate instead of looping forever.

cases.title: Cleanup removes the junction link but keeps the target contents
cases.description: When an installed path is a junction link, cleanup removes the link only and must not delete the junction target's contents.
cases.pass_criteria: link removed == true and target contents intact == true

cases.title: Service account password change updates the stored credential
cases.description: Changing the DSH service account password updates the credential store.
cases.pass_criteria: stored credential hash equals the new password hash

cases.title: Service is restarted after a credential change
cases.description: After the credential is updated the service must be restarted so the new logon takes effect.
cases.pass_criteria: restart counter incremented and service running after change

cases.title: Failed password change preserves the previous credential
cases.description: If updating the service credential fails, the previous credential must be preserved and a clear error returned (no lockout / no partial write).
cases.pass_criteria: on simulated update failure the store keeps the old credential and an error is reported

coverage.note: COV-1 (T10 §4.3): every declared scenario class must have at least one case; the dataset builder (T11) must reject a dataset that lacks a class.
